title: When the Language Falls
author: Beatrix Winterbourne
blurb: Bram Coldharbour, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
